# Default Batoi PHP Distribution

RAD ships Batoi AIF under `aif/` as a Composer-independent PHP drop-in. RAD
registers its autoloader when the package is present, but applications must
explicitly configure and invoke AIF features.

Batoi UIF is a client-side distribution and is therefore shipped from
`public_html/assets/uif/`, not from `rad/vendor/`. RAD Admin retains a
synchronized runtime copy under `rad/admin/assets/uif/` for its admin asset
route.

The remaining contents of `rad/vendor/` are generated by Composer and are not
tracked. Licenses and upstream documentation are included with both bundled
distribution.

MCP Audit is intentionally not bundled. It is a platform-specific security CLI
for development and CI rather than a RAD runtime dependency. Install it from
its own releases when a deployment pipeline needs MCP policy auditing.
